description: Page views and unique visitors per day for a published site, plus its top pages and the websites that sent visitors. Counted on the server with no cookies; search bots, previews and Pagetool's own checks are not counted. days defaults to 30 (max 90). Free.

days.description: How many days back, including today (UTC). Default 30, max 90.

site_key.description: The site whose visits to read. Must be yours (or granted to the operator token).

name: site_stats
title: Visits to a site
